case_question: My car ran very smoothly last month and today I got an engine failure. What exactly caused the engine failure?
verdict: Engine failed from cooling-system failure -> repeated overheating -> head-gasket breach -> coolant diluting the oil -> loss of oil pressure and rod-bearing seizure (cyl 3/4). Not oil starvation, not flood water, not battery, not fuel.

root_cause_chain.what: Cooling system degraded at a non-OEM 30k service (QuickFix): coolant flush billed but not done (no level/quality change in data, 55-min visit), topped up with ~1.1 L tap water + 0.4 L concentrate, OEM 1.1 bar radiator cap replaced with 0.9 bar universal cap, 15W-40 CF-4 oil instead of 5W-30 C3.
Low-boiling-margin cooling system vents coolant on hot/loaded runs; water-pump seal weeps slowly from July; coolant level declines ~0.2 %/day; temperature margins shrink.
evidence: events: traffic overheat 2026-09-03 109 C (P0217), cleared by owner 2026-09-04

root_cause_chain.what: Low-coolant lamp (level < 70 %) and P2181 appear; owner ignores 2 days then tops up with plain tap water on 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-20 - treating the symptom, hiding the leak, further diluting glycol.
Second overheat (107 C) in stop-go traffic; P0217 stored. From 2026-10-17 oil level starts rising (coolant ingress) and hot-idle oil pressure drifts down.

Highway jam, AC on: coolant peaks 118.6 C at 16:58; ~37 min above 105 C; reservoir boils over 87.5 -> 56.9 %. Owner kept driving ~2 h on red warning. Head gasket breached; coolant enters oil and cylinders.

Cold start: white smoke, misfires cyl 3/4, oil level 110 %+, oil pressure collapses from ~210 to <40 kPa within 3 minutes under load (~1.4 km, 4.5 min after key-on), knock rises, coolant sensor reads steam (~32 -> 118 C in ~37 s), engine stalls and will not turn (rod bearing seized).

contributing_factors: Wrong oil grade (CF-4 15W-40) accelerating DPF loading and raising cold oil pressure ~8%
Missed inspection chance at brake job 2026-08-02
Continued driving on red temperature warning

ruled_out.why: Dry air filter, no DTC, oil level/pressure normal for 11 months afterwards

ruled_out.hypothesis: Oil starvation from low oil level
ruled_out.why: Oil level ROSE to ~110 % in last week (coolant ingress); oil pressure only fell after contamination
Dashcam parasitic draw already fixed 2026-02-18; cranking V normal since; P0562 history only
Resolved 2026-08-18 (drain); injector corrections back to normal by 2026-08-19
Repaired 2026-03-10; only minor extra heat load afterwards
30k service done on time (04-04); problem was service quality, not lateness
Unrelated systems; pads and puncture repaired

what_would_have_prevented: OEM 1.1 bar cap + real flush with 50:50 premix
Pressure test + hose/pump inspection at service
Stop the car at the red temperature warning on 2026-10-22
confidence: High (0.9) on chain: cooling failure -> overheat -> head gasket -> oil contamination -> bearing failure. Medium on exact failed component (water-pump seal vs hose) until teardown.

coolant_sample.note: hard-water scale deposits in radiator tubes

post_failure_inspection_synthetic.head_gasket: breach cyl 3-4 to coolant jacket; combustion gas test positive
post_failure_inspection_synthetic.engine: cyl-3 big-end bearing spun, crank journal scored, rod bent; engine seized
